description: Shipkit session start: tells Claude the plugin root and prints a one-line reminder when PROJECT_MAP.md or a spec has drifted from HEAD; then injects each always-on rule (one hook command per rule — Claude Code caps a hook's context contribution at ~10K chars per command) unless /shipkit:setup installed the rules as files. Before a Bash call: blocks a git commit that would include a staged file that looks like a secret (.env, *.pem, *.key, id_rsa*, credentials*.json)
